f9abe27246df.en: The whole chapter in one line: on the menu of candidates, find the dish with the lowest score.

42cdd74b7ccb.zh: 餐廳賣什麼菜？線性模型 = 義大利麵專賣；神經網路 = 分子創意餐廳。所有候選函式的集合 $\mathcal{F}$ 即選單。Linear = pasta shop; neural net = molecular gastronomy.
42cdd74b7ccb.en: What dishes does the restaurant serve? A linear model = a pasta-only shop; a neural network = a creative molecular-gastronomy restaurant. The set $\mathcal{F}$ of all candidate functions is the menu.

0522c99ea564.zh: 毒舌評論家打分：差越多分越高（損失大），越好吃分越低。目標是讓損失最小。Bigger gap = higher loss; want minimal.
0522c99ea564.en: A sharp-tongued critic hands out scores: the further off the dish is, the higher the score (large loss); the tastier it is, the lower the score. The goal is to make the loss as small as possible.

7bf416db5146.zh: 在迷霧大山找最低山谷：梯度下降像盲人摸象，一步步往下走到碗底。Foggy mountain: gradient descent steps to valley.
7bf416db5146.en: Finding the lowest valley on a fog-covered mountain: gradient descent is like the blind men feeling the elephant, walking downhill step by step until it reaches the bottom of the bowl.

006e9df5bcca.zh: 「最佳模型 $\hat{f}$ 就是在選單 $\mathcal{F}$ 裡找讓評分 $S(f)$ 最低的那一個。」Best model = lowest scoring dish on the menu.
006e9df5bcca.en: “The best model $\hat{f}$ is the one on the menu $\mathcal{F}$ that makes the score $S(f)$ the lowest.”

73682046d1d8.zh: $:=$ 是「定義為」、$\arg\min$ 是「讓最小的引數」、$f \in \mathcal{F}$ 是「在選單裡」。$:=$ defines, $\arg\min$ = arg achieving min.
73682046d1d8.en: $:=$ means “is defined as”, $\arg\min$ means “the argument that makes it smallest”, and $f \in \mathcal{F}$ means “on the menu”.
